spec: solar-verify's export of verify_counter.sol in this run (Certified.verify_counter.gen.Counter.Spec.Counter): bump(n) ensures count == old(count) + n and the invariant count <= limit, read by Shapes.bundlePost; increment and max are in the export and do not apply to the valid calls (other selectors). Allowed statuses: success, Panic(0x11) or Error("over") (ShapeSource.Allowed)
excluded: source model trusted: SolidCore's checked Counter (the solc AST through scripts/solc_ast_to_lean_source.py and the type checker) is the meaning of the source (frontend trust boundary)

source to MIR: SolidCore's runtime run equals solar's first lowered MIR on every valid call (Contracts.VerifyCounter.StageSource.mir_eq, from the generic erasure of bump with the loop's kernel-checked ranking certificate); the backend from MIR to the bytes is Contracts.VerifyCounter.Shape.functional and resources
deployment: the init code is not covered; runtime bytecode from any storage
calls: one frame, caller 0x2000, contract at 0x1000, the block and transaction of Target.message
valid calls: bump(uint256) with ABI call data, no value, any storage, argument n < 2^32 (where the gas bound stays below 2^64); count(), limit(), increment() and max() are outside this statement
resources: gas bound Bump.gasBound call, linear in n, coarse (22100 gas per item)
